prompt: What was the total margin of each parent category in 2025, in whole euros? Use the sales table and keep the order lines with an order_date from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, both included. A line's margin is net_revenue_eur minus units times unit_cost_eur; a line with a missing net_revenue_eur, units or unit_cost_eur has a missing margin and adds nothing to the total. Return two columns, in this order: parent_category and margin_eur, the sum of the line margins rounded to whole euros with ROUND(x, 0). Return one row per parent_category. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, keep the 2025 lines and write the calculated column margin_eur, one total per parent_category.

Add up the full line margins and round once, around the total. Rounding each line first adds up many small errors. Work out each line's margin inside the SUM, so a line with a missing value drops out as a whole.
why_this_works: Rounding once around the SUM keeps every cent until the end, and computing the margin per line inside the SUM drops a line with a missing value as a whole.
